title: Transport of global Hom comparisons across a counit square
statement: Let $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ be a cartesian square of schemes with maps $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g_X:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $F=Rf_*$, $F'=Rf'_*$, $L=Lg^*$, $L_X=Lg_X^*$ for derived direct image and pullback [def-pc-derived-direct-image, def-pc-derived-pullback] and $\beta:LF\to F'L_X$ for canonical base change [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $E\in D(\mathcal O_{X'})$, $K\in D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and let $t:L_XN\to E$, $e:FN\to K$, $e':F'E\to LK$ satisfy $\beta_N;F'(t);e'=L(e)$. Assume only that $\beta_M$ is invertible. Write $H_Z(P,Q)$ for global derived Hom [def-pc-global-derived-rhom], $S_h$ for scalar restriction, $p_h$ for its canonical pullback comparison [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison], $d_h$ for the evaluation-mate direct-image comparison used in [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction], and $s:S_fS_{g_X}\cong S_gS_{f'}$ for the scalar square identification. Then the following morphisms from $S_f H_X(M,N)$ to $S_g H_{Y'}(F'L_XM,LK)$ are equal: $S_f(p_{g_X};S_{g_X}H_{X'}(1,t));s;S_g(d_{f'};H_{Y'}(1,e'))$ and $(d_f;H_Y(1,e));p_g;S_gH_{Y'}(\beta_M^{-1},1)$. No right adjoints to $F,F'$ are assumed.

proof.text: Prove naturality in the second Hom entry directly from the fixed constructions. For the pullback comparison, transpose under the pullback adjunction, then the tensor-Hom bijection. Tensor-Hom naturality and naturality of the inverse pullback-tensor comparison identify the resulting evaluation composites; apply global sections and Leray naturality. For direct image, use naturality of the chosen evaluation-mate natural transformation, apply global sections, and move the input map through the inverse Leray comparison. These are the proved private helpers pullbackMate_naturality, pullback_naturality and directImage_naturality.

Apply the base-change exchange square at (M,N). Postcompose both paths with global Hom of (beta_M inverse, Rf prime(t) followed by e prime). Functoriality in the product category and beta_M inverse followed by beta_M = identity reduce the first Hom entry to the identity. The assumed counit equation replaces beta_N followed by Rf prime(t) and e prime with Lg*(e). This gives the equation core in the Lean proof.

Scalar-square naturality moves Hom(1,t) through the scalar identification. Direct-image naturality moves it through d_f prime. Pullback-comparison naturality moves Hom(1,e) through p_g on the right. Combine the consecutive global Hom maps by functoriality; the resulting equation is precisely core, which proves the original assertion unchanged.

theorem schemeGlobalHom_baseChange_counit_transport
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (M N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (E : schemeDerivedCategory (pullback f g))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (t : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N ⟶ E)
    (e : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj N ⟶ K)
    (e' : (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj E ⟶
      (derivedPullback g).obj K)
    [IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
      (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition M)]
    (h : schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition N ≫
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map t ≫ e' =
        (derivedPullback g).map e) :
    (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction f).map
      (schemeGlobalDerivedHom_pullback_comparison (pullback.fst f g) M N ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction (pullback.fst f g)).map
          ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom (pullback f g)).map ((𝟙 _).op, t))) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarSquareIso f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition).hom.app
          ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom (pullback f g)).obj
            (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M), E)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        (schemeGlobalHomDirectImageMap (pullback.snd f g)
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M) E ≫
          (schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map ((𝟙 _).op, e')) =
    (schemeGlobalHomDirectImageMap f M N ≫
        (schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y).map ((𝟙 _).op, e)) ≫
      schemeGlobalDerivedHom_pullback_comparison g
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M) K ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
        ((schemeGlobalDerivedHom Y').map
          (X := (op ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M)),
            (derivedPullback g).obj K))
          (Y := (op ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)), (derivedPullback g).obj K))
          ((inv (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
            (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition M)).op, 𝟙 _))
